representativeOrder.scenario: Standard×3 + Premium Unlimited×3, no promo, fresh user created mid-checkout via REGISTER & SAVE INFO

steps.businessName: click Tickets button on landing view
steps.notes: Same as guest-checkout step 1. Wait for visible #add buttons on tickets view.

steps.businessName: click ADD on the Standard ticket card (transitions card to quantity widget)
steps.notes: Registry: `Bubble shared IDs: #add and #add-item disambiguated by visibility + DOM order`. Initial visible #add order: 0=Standard, 1=Premium, 2=Std Unlimited, 3=Prem Unlimited. Click visible idx 0 for Standard.

steps.businessName: click + on Standard card (2nd unit, qty 1→2)
steps.notes: Only Standard's card has the widget right now, so visible #add-item idx 0 is Standard. Registry: Bubble shared IDs.

steps.businessName: click + on Standard card (3rd unit, qty 2→3)
steps.notes: Same as step 3, visible #add-item idx 0.

steps.businessName: click ADD on Premium Unlimited card (transitions card to quantity widget)
steps.notes: Standard is active so its #add is gone. Visible #add order is now: 0=Premium, 1=Std Unlimited, 2=Prem Unlimited. Click visible idx 2. Disambiguate by scanning closest card container text (`Standard|Premium|Standard Unlimited|Premium Unlimited`). Registry: Bubble shared IDs.

steps.businessName: click + on Premium Unlimited card (2nd unit, qty 1→2)
steps.notes: Two widgets visible now — idx 0=Standard, idx 1=Premium Unlimited (DOM order matches card order; Premium skipped because never activated). Click visible #add-item idx 1. Verify via closest-container text scan (type = Premium Unlimited).

steps.businessName: click + on Premium Unlimited card (3rd unit, qty 2→3)
steps.notes: Same as step 6, visible #add-item idx 1.

steps.businessName: click PROCEED TO CHECKOUT
steps.class: clickable-element bubble-element Group cnpqaZ0 bubble-r-container relative
steps.notes: Unique id. Click via el.click(). Wait for #main-full-name to appear (~2s).

steps.businessName: fill Contact Info Full Name on Step 1
steps.notes: Registry: `Bubble input: el.value = x does not register — native setter + events required`. Use the fillBubbleInput helper (native value setter + input/change events). Plain assignment or fill() does not register.

steps.businessName: fill Contact Info Email on Step 1
steps.notes: Same native-setter pattern as step 9. Timestamped per-run — Registry: `Unique contact email per run`. The exact email captured for this discovery run is in representativeOrder.signupEmailUsed.

steps.businessName: check 'contact info is same for all tickets' checkbox on Step 1
steps.text: checkThe contact information is the same for all tickets
steps.notes: Bubble checkbox rendered as a clickable Group DIV. After checking, per-ticket fields auto-fill with the Contact Info name + email. Registry: `Bubble Step-1: both checkboxes required`.

steps.businessName: check 'authorized cardholder' consent checkbox at bottom of Step 1
steps.class: clickable-element bubble-element Group cpmaJo1 bubble-r-container flex row
steps.text: I am the authorized cardholder for this purchase...
steps.notes: NO id. Registry: `Bubble Step-1: authorized cardholder checkbox has no ID`. Select via class+text: `Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.clickable-element.bubble-element.Group')).find(e => e.textContent.includes('authorized cardholder'))`.

steps.businessName: click REGISTER & SAVE INFO on Step 1 (opens the signup popup)
steps.notes: IMPORTANT: this is the same Bubble element as the post-signup CONTINUE button (see step 18). Its TEXT changes from 'REGISTER & SAVE INFO' → 'CONTINUE' after signup; its ID #continue-registered-user is stable. Click via document.getElementById('continue-registered-user').click(). Opens the 'Create an 8Count profile' popup (does NOT transform Step 1 inline — it overlays a popup at high z-index).

steps.businessName: wait for 'Create an 8Count profile' popup to render
steps.notes: The popup has no stable ID on its container. Anchor the wait on the heading text or the appearance of a visible `input[type=password]` (the only such inputs on this page). Registry: `UI transitions: wait for specific visible elements`. Reference anchor for signup popup is `heading "Create an 8Count profile"` (level 2).

steps.businessName: fill Email in the signup popup (empty on open — does NOT inherit from Step 1)
steps.notes: CONFIRMED: popup Email field starts EMPTY even though Step 1 #main-email was filled. Must re-fill. Registry: `Bubble Step-1 (Guest→Register): popup Email field starts empty`. Target via `placeholder="Email"` on a type=email input with NO id, filtered to offsetParent !== null, AND filtered out per-ticket email rows by requiring id === null. Use fillBubbleInput's native-setter + input/change pattern (Bubble input — Registry: Bubble input).

steps.businessName: fill Password in the signup popup
steps.notes: NO id. `input[type=password][placeholder="Password"]` with autocomplete="new-password". 1st of two visible password inputs (Password then Confirm password). Use native-setter pattern (Registry: Bubble input).

steps.businessName: fill Confirm password in the signup popup
steps.notes: NO id. `input[type=password][placeholder="Confirm password"]` with autocomplete="new-password". 2nd of two visible password inputs. Use native-setter pattern.

steps.businessName: click SIGN UP in the signup popup
steps.notes: NO id — the signup submit button must be targeted by text. Select `Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).filter(e => /^SIGN UP$/i.test((e.textContent||'').trim())).filter(e => e.offsetParent !== null)[0]`. NOTE: this is DIFFERENT from the Step 1 REGISTER & SAVE INFO button (#continue-registered-user, step 13) — the popup has its own submit. After clicking, popup closes, user is logged in, and Step 1 REGISTER & SAVE INFO button re-labels to 'CONTINUE' (same element, same ID).

steps.businessName: wait for post-signup state — popup closed, logged-in signal visible
steps.notes: Post-signup signals: (a) the password input disappears (`!document.querySelector('input[type=password]:not([disabled])')` NOT reliable because Bubble may keep the popup's inputs disabled-but-present briefly), (b) `#continue-registered-user.textContent` changes from 'REGISTER & SAVE INFO' to 'CONTINUE' — USE THIS as the primary signal, (c) top-right 'Login' link replaced by 'Logout' in the tickets header (observed in this run). Recommended wait: `document.getElementById('continue-registered-user') && /^CONTINUE$/i.test((document.getElementById('continue-registered-user').textContent||'').trim())`.

steps.businessName: click CONTINUE on Step 1 (logged-in exit — advances to Step 2)
steps.notes: Same element as step 13, text changed to 'CONTINUE' after successful signup. Same click pattern. Wait for #complete-order-authnet and #toggle-terms to appear on Step 2.

steps.businessName: click '+ Add Payment Method' on Step 2 (fresh user has no saved card)
steps.notes: Registry: `Authorize.net: "Add Payment Method" detour for first-order-per-logged-in-user`. Detour applies because the signup in step 18 created a brand-new Bubble user with no saved card — PAY NOW is inert without one. Clicking redirects to https://test.authorize.net/customer/addPayment (NOT payment/payment). Feature-detection pattern: check `document.getElementById('btn-wg-add-payment-method') && document.getElementById('btn-wg-add-payment-method').offsetParent !== null`; if present, take the detour before clicking PAY NOW.

steps.businessName: fill Authorize.net customer/addPayment form (card + billing)
steps.notes: Registry: `Authorize.net: fill() silently ignored, validation requires pressSequentially`, `Authorize.net: field names are not the American spellings`, `Authorize.net: expiry date must be digits only`, `Authorize.net: First/Last name auto-populate from Step 1`. Fields: #cardNum='4007000000027', #expiryDate='0427' (digits only), #cvv='123', input[name="firstName"]='GP' (SEE newGotchas — NOT auto-populated on customer/addPayment, contradicts payment/payment behavior), input[name="lastName"]='TestUser' (triple-click + pressSequentially to overwrite), input[name="zip"]='10001', input[name="address"]='123 Test Street', input[name="city"]='New York', input[name="state"]='NY'. Use pressSequentially with delay: 30-40ms for every field.

steps.businessName: click SAVE on Authorize.net customer/addPayment (saves the card, no charge)
steps.notes: Registry: `Authorize.net: "Add Payment Method" detour...` (SAVE, not Pay). Selector: `page.locator('button:has-text("SAVE")').first()` — rendered uppercase. SAVE stays disabled if ANY required field is empty — notably firstName must be filled manually (see step 22 newGotcha). After click, page shows 'Your information has been saved.\nContinue'.

steps.businessName: click Continue on Authorize.net confirmation to return to Bubble
steps.notes: Registry: `Authorize.net: wait for Continue button after Pay, then click to return to Bubble` (same pattern applies on the addPayment confirmation). Selector: `page.locator('button:has-text("Continue")').first()`. Returns to Bubble at `?tab=tickets&authcreate=yes`.

steps.businessName: re-toggle Terms & Conditions (reset after addPayment round-trip)
steps.notes: Registry: `Bubble ionic-toggle: resets after Authorize.net Add-Payment-Method detour` + `Bubble ionic-toggle: outer div click silently no-ops — click inner <label>`. CONFIRMED in this run: checkbox was unchecked after return. Click inner label: `document.getElementById('toggle-terms').querySelector('label').click()`. Verify `#toggle-terms input[type=checkbox]` is `checked=true` before PAY NOW.

steps.businessName: click PAY NOW on Step 2 — completes order WITHOUT Authorize.net redirect
steps.notes: Registry: `Authorize.net: "Add Payment Method" detour...` — second PAY NOW completes immediately (charges the saved card server-side). CONFIRMED in this run: URL stays on `8countlogin.com/.../?tab=tickets` (NO redirect to test.authorize.net), and the page transitions directly to 'Order Confirmed' heading. Order #BHTDH-9017 created; Bubble total $492.03.

steps.businessName: wait for success signal (Order Confirmed heading)
steps.notes: For this flow the success signal is the 'Order Confirmed' heading text — NOT the `?success=yes` URL flag. CONFIRMED in this run: `location.search` stayed at `?tab=tickets` (no `success=yes`) while body text cleanly showed 'Order Confirmed\nOrder #BHTDH-9017'. Guest-checkout's waitForSuccess OR-check (`location.search.includes('success=yes') || <heading regex>`) still works because the heading branch fires here. See newGotchas for why this branch of the OR fires in this flow.

newGotchas.title: Bubble Step-1 (Guest→Register): REGISTER & SAVE INFO and post-signup CONTINUE share ID #continue-registered-user
newGotchas.symptom: Writing two different selectors for the REGISTER button and the post-signup CONTINUE button yields two names for the same DOM element. The button's ID is stable; only its text changes after signup success.
newGotchas.cause: Bubble re-uses the same Button element for both states; conditional text swaps REGISTER & SAVE INFO ↔ CONTINUE based on the current-user state.
newGotchas.fix: Use `#continue-registered-user` for BOTH clicks (the pre-signup REGISTER and the post-signup advance-to-Step-2 CONTINUE). Wait between the two clicks by polling for the text flip: `/^CONTINUE$/i.test((document.getElementById('continue-registered-user').textContent||'').trim())` — this is the most reliable post-signup signal.

newGotchas.title: Authorize.net customer/addPayment: firstName is NOT auto-populated from Step 1 (contradicts payment/payment behavior)
newGotchas.symptom: SAVE button stays disabled after pressSequentially'ing every documented field. Inspecting form values shows `input[name="firstName"]` is empty.
newGotchas.cause: The Gotchas Registry entry `Authorize.net: First/Last name auto-populate from Step 1` describes behavior on the regular `payment/payment` redirect. The `customer/addPayment` variant only auto-populates lastName (from Step 1 Full Name last word) — firstName arrives empty, is required, and blocks SAVE.
newGotchas.fix: On customer/addPayment, fill BOTH firstName and lastName explicitly via triple-click + pressSequentially. Existing lastName overwrite is fine; add a firstName fill before SAVE. Split the Step 1 full name on whitespace and pass first/last tokens, or use fixed tokens from settings.payment (firstName e.g. 'GP', lastName 'TestUser').

newGotchas.title: guest-to-register-checkout: 2nd PAY NOW returns 'Order Confirmed' in-place — NO `?success=yes` URL flag, NO Authorize.net redirect
newGotchas.symptom: After the Add-Payment-Method detour, the second PAY NOW (with a saved card) completes inline. URL stays on `?tab=tickets` — no redirect to test.authorize.net and no `?success=yes` flag ever appears.
newGotchas.cause: Bubble charges the saved card server-side via a backend workflow, then replaces the Step 2 DOM with the Order Confirmed view. The `?success=yes` flag is set by the Authorize.net return redirect — it cannot fire when Authorize.net isn't part of the path.
newGotchas.fix: For this flow, `waitForSuccess` must key on the Order Confirmed heading text — the existing OR-check (`location.search.includes('success=yes') || <heading regex>`) already handles this correctly because the heading branch fires. Flow-specific callers should NOT assume `?success=yes` is reachable.

newGotchas.title: Authorize.net addPayment return URL flag: `?authcreate=yes` (not `?success=yes`)
newGotchas.symptom: Watching location.search for the return-to-Bubble signal after the addPayment Continue button finds `?tab=tickets&authcreate=yes` — not any `success` flag.
newGotchas.cause: Bubble distinguishes between card-saved-only returns (`authcreate=yes`) and purchase-succeeded returns (`success=yes`). The addPayment detour produces the former; only the main payment/payment flow produces the latter.
newGotchas.fix: If the runner ever needs to confirm the addPayment round-trip landed (vs. still on test.authorize.net), key on `location.host === '8countlogin.com'` or `location.search.includes('authcreate=yes')`. Do NOT wait for `success=yes` at this intermediate point — it won't come until after the second PAY NOW in flows that redirect (guest), and it NEVER comes in this flow.
